Scheduling lane: research. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Research comparison retained; frozen exposure/eligibility rules apply. Not an engineering prerequisite or proof of behavioral recovery.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 1b Human ceiling; docs/plans/2026-09-03-within-scene-precision-preregistration.md.

The within-scene machine lane scored 66.1% against a 25.0% midpoint null but is diagnostic only; the human lane has zero comparisons and no answers file exists.

Scope:
Run the preregistered human lane; this needs one person for about 90 minutes, not the second-coding team.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The answering person is recorded by role; the packet used matches the preregistered packet's hash.
2. The answers file lives in the ignored data root; its hash is committed.
3. The lane is scored with the preregistered scorer and the result is recorded in the ledger.

Gate: every script in tools/recall-study/tests exits 0 (`for t in tools/recall-study/tests/test_*.py;
do python3 "$t" || exit 1; done`), new tests included; a named mutation witness per new guard; no
recall prose or participant text committed (hashes and aggregates only); fresh-context cold review;
the commit body states the evidence and what it does not establish.

Size: S.

2026-09-22 operative workflow reconciliation (docs/plans/2026-09-22-recall-encoding-workflow.md):
Preserve the existing preregistered packet, human-lane scoring and closure criteria unchanged. This fixed diagnostic is not a fine-time gold standard and cannot by itself qualify the continuous uncertainty maps in the new workflow. General fine-localization validation/observation-model design is owned by the existing reliability ticket bd-01M2TAEW794XCR7D2HZJFNXVJY; new human collection still requires the applicable resources/approval. Do not retrofit the old packet or call its completion calibration.
